title: The Best Wi-Fi Smart Scales
subtitle: Wi-Fi bathroom scales that sync your weight automatically, ranked.
intro: We pulled the Wi-Fi smart scales on Amazon and scored them on rating, review volume, and features: automatic Wi-Fi sync, body composition, multiple users, and health app support.
systems_note: Only Wi-Fi scales are included, so readings sync without your phone nearby. Many popular scales are Bluetooth only.

buyers_guide.q: How accurate are body composition scales?
buyers_guide.a: Weight is accurate to a few tenths of a pound. Body fat and muscle numbers from foot sensors are estimates; use them to see trends, not exact values.
Wi-Fi scales sync on their own every time you step on. Bluetooth scales need your phone nearby with the app open.

buyers_guide.q: Does it work with Apple Health and Google Fit?
buyers_guide.a: Most do, along with apps like Fitbit or MyFitnessPal. Check the listing for the ones you use.
